tests: a type library imported on Available COM References is listed in Enabled Libraries as [LINKED-PACKAGE]
steps:
1. Press Ctrl+T for Project Settings' references, open Available COM References and press Import from file...; pick C:\Windows\SysWOW64\msdatsrc.tlb.
2. The project gains the reference [IMPORTED] Microsoft Data Source Interfaces for ActiveX Data Binding Type Library.
3. Open Enabled Libraries: the row reads [LINKED-PACKAGE] Microsoft Data Source Interfaces ...
